quote: Whenever a usable path for bicycles, electric bicycles, or electric scooters has been provided adjacent to a roadway, riders of bicycles, electric bicycles, and electric scooters shall use such path and shall not use the roadway.

activation.condition: Usable provided path for a covered rider is adjacent to a roadway.

obligation.description: Covered rider uses the path and does not use the roadway.

timing.description: Observe the rider and path throughout the original route.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Original condition, physical continuity and access restrictions require independent review.
Municipal designation, extent and relationship to the roadway require original source review.

parameter_refs.range_or_domain: bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter

parameter_refs.range_or_domain: usable or unusable after source review
